title: The Heavens Through the Webb Telescope
subtitle: Surah Ar-Rahman and Surah Al-Mulk

content.alt: The Heavens Through the Webb Telescope

content.text: In 2022 the James Webb Space Telescope sent back its first pictures. One showed the "Cosmic Cliffs" of the Carina Nebula, about 7,600 light-years away, where the tallest peaks of gas and dust are about 7 light-years high and new stars are being born inside them. Another showed the galaxy NGC 7496, some 24 million light-years away, with glowing lanes of dust and gas where stars are forming.
Every day He is at work

content.alt: يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ (Qur'an 55:29)

content.text: "Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks of Him. Every day He is at some work."
Stars being born in clouds trillions of miles tall: this is some of that work, happening right now, by His command كُن فَيَكُونُ "Be, and it is".

content.alt: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ ۝ ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ (Qur'an 67:3–4)

content.text: "He created seven heavens in layers. You will see no flaw in the creation of the Most Merciful. Look again: do you see any cracks? Then look again and again; your sight will come back to you humbled and tired."
We now look with telescopes a million times sharper than the eye, and the challenge still stands. Read the Qur'an in Arabic and understand it, and see its wonders for yourself.
